description: A bearded man in a dark coat and wide-brimmed hat sits on a stone quay at a wooden easel, holding a palette and brushes, painting. Behind him a harbour at sunset: tall-masted sailing ships on the left, a steamship with a funnel trailing black smoke on the right, and a low orange sun in a hazy sky. The water reflects gold light in loose, broken brushstrokes. A dark rectangular wooden frame leans against the wall in the lower-left corner, and dark stone pillars run down the left and right edges. No text is visible.
reason: A dark wooden picture frame leans against the wall in the lower-left corner, so the painting does not fill the image edge to edge. Crop it out or repaint that corner without the frame.
